summary: Regression pass for Odoo Sync resiliency fixes (retryWrites/socketTimeoutMS, bulk() 4x retry on AutoReconnect/NetworkTimeout/ConnectionFailure with ordered=False, message batch size 500). Backend: POST /api/admin/sync/start -> 200 (run_id 13), polled GET /api/admin/sync/runs/13 -> status 'done' in ~6s with NO error and full progress/results for catalogs, users, templates, leads, lead_messages, wa_channels, wa_messages, contacts, open_activities. GET /api/admin/sync/status -> 200 with last_record + counts populated after run. Frontend: admin login OK, Admin > Migration tab, sync-now-button click opens sync-confirm-modal, sync-confirm-button fires start (Sync started toast), button label -> 'Sync in progress…', sync-progress panel renders live counts, after ~8s button returns to 'Sync Now' and green 'Sync #14 complete — 2 new, 138 updated' summary is shown with per-entity counts. No regression.
critical_code_review_comments: bulk() retry wrapper with ordered=False + backoff is correct; message batch reduced 2000->500 lowers memory/socket pressure per bulk_write.
MongoClient timeouts (socketTimeoutMS=180000 + retryWrites=True) are reasonable for large chatter bulk_write; consider also setting maxPoolSize appropriately in prod if not already.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview dataset small, delta sync completes in ~6-8s; real prod transient AutoReconnect cannot be reproduced here. Regression path clean: start->done->status all 200, UI button lifecycle + progress panel healthy.
rca of the issue: Prod-side pymongo AutoReconnect during large lead-chatter bulk_write. Fix: retryWrites=True + 180s socketTimeout on client, explicit 4x retry with ordered=False in bulk() to skip idempotent duplicates on reconnect, and smaller message batches (500) to shrink each write frame.
